about: Commitment to the Q-119 hold-out test set (n8n AI output guard). The cases were written by a separate session that does not build the guard, from tests/CASES.md and tests/schemas/ only, and sealed before the guard build. This file holds only counts and the archive hash, no case content.
count_per_status_rule: first listed expected status of each case; 3 live correct cases also accept ok_after_retry, and 1 gated-false subtle injection case also accepts needs_review
how_to_open: At the final run only: take holdout.zip from the folder q119-holdout in the owner's user profile. Check that its SHA-256 equals archive_sha256; if it does not, the hold-out result is void. Then unzip it and follow README.txt inside.
